//: Lighthouse CI — mobile. Budgets guard the five metrics we care about.
The numbers are the measured values with headroom, not the measured
values themselves: a GitHub runner is a shared two-core box, noisier and
slower than a developer machine, and a budget set at the measurement is a
build that fails on a bad afternoon rather than on a regression.
Median-of-3 against the built output at the time of writing:
CLS and TBT are absolute rather than relative: 0.1 is the Core Web Vitals
'good' boundary and this site sits at zero, so they catch a real fault
instead of tracking a moving baseline.
Runs against the built static output, so the check is deterministic and
runs on every PR. CDN headers and edge latency are Netlify's checks.
